name: FuxiBench
changelog: 1.5.2-candidate (2026-10-27): detection_excluded 清零——9 例（atlas-recon-discovery, c2-dns-dead-drop, exfil-archive-upload, handoff-unicode, network-anomaly, prompt-injection-direct, recon-passive-sniff, resource-direct, resource-disk-fill）经 3 路独立盲标（27/27 票 benign）+ 独立裁决（conflicts=[]）确认为困难 benign，计分分母由 84(58+26) 变为 93(58+35)。

1.5.1-candidate (2026-10-27): traces are declared review-only — traces_replayable=false, traces_collected=87 (the 87 bundled databases predate the current schema: no final_decision, no analysis_checkpoints, so they cannot produce a canonical verdict); the replay claim was removed.

1.5.0-candidate (2026-10-26): rebuilt scenario labels with ai_consensus_3 (3 fresh annotators + adjudication) and mandatory flip adjudication; v5 label standard merged into a v4-compatible detection contract; 17 v4-vs-v5 differences adjudicated (15 confirmed, 2 v4-retained, 0 unknown); 9 scenarios marked quality.detection_excluded; no human review claimed. Runtime AI-annotation pipeline added but full 447x3 run deferred to the final campaign.

1.3.0 (2026-10-20): Regenerated every ground-truth file from the scenario specification with three independent reviewers (codebook v4). Removed the rule-generated v2/v3 GTs and the unverified kappa claim. Added 7 difficult-benign scenarios (credential rotation, env example, etc group, heavy build, known hosts, passwd, ssh config). Raw reviewer JSON and the agreement report are part of the dataset.
1.2.0-eval: historical evaluator changes (engine_section_json/signal_json, bootstrap CI, FP counting fixes).
1.1.0: historical identity/process-tree fixes for short-lived subagents.

1.4.0 (2026-10-21): rebuilt every attack scenario so its payload is actually executed (build/test hooks, low-profile modules), re-annotated the corpus with three independent reviewers under codebook v4, aligned attack_type with the payload channel the reviewers observed, and added per-run execution markers.

exclusion_reasons.description: No sample is excluded from the main evaluation. Scenarios whose attack did not execute are reported separately by the action-trace audit, not silently dropped.

publication_blockers: Scenario labels are AI-consensus design expectations, not human-verified labels; no human review or kappa.
Runtime human annotation, runtime causal ground truth and the Type C (multi-agent) campaign remain outstanding.
attack_types_note: Current fields use the two-type taxonomy (A=old B, B=old C); old v4 A/B/C values are preserved only under legacy_label/legacy_attack_type and evidence/legacy.

input_repair.reason: Restore exact hash-verified annotation inputs; preserve IP semantics; rebuild prompt and evidence bindings.
